facts: A pair of threshold objects (tall frost covered pillars) stands 0.9-2.7 m inside the door, with a hanging screen (steaming hanging curtain of ice) between them; the route slips through a 1.1 m gap.
The hero (slowly melting ice monolith) stands alone in an empty 5 x 6 m area (void of melting sound resonance); the route circles it and never comes closer than 2.7 m.
Four product stations (skincare test pedestal) sit at the outer corners, outside the loop, so you turn away from the hero to reach them.
The pay desk (minimalist cashier monolith) closes the loop at the back wall.
anchors: standing just inside the door, between the threshold objects; you look at the tall frost covered pillars (joint_column)
at the edge of the void, facing the hero; you look at the slowly melting ice monolith (rock)
turned away from the hero, at a product station; you look at the skincare test pedestal (display)

args.title: Tamburins: The Glacial Echo
args.subtitle: A sensory journey through glacial time.
args.line: Experience the transient beauty of a glacier as it echoes through scent and light.
args.synopsis: You enter through a curtain of frozen vapor into a realm of deep, resonant silence. At the center of the space, a slowly melting ice monolith commands your attention, its gradual decline marking the passage of cold time. As you orbit this frozen heart, you encounter skincare stations placed to draw you into quiet reflection. Finally, you reach the back, where the echoes of melting water transition into the tactile experience of Tamburins' collection.
args.quote: In the melt, we find the origin of stillness.

why.d: These pillars and the curtain of ice create a cold, crisp transition that cleanses your senses as you enter.
The slowly melting ice monolith acts as the silent anchor of the store, drawing you into a rhythmic orbit of contemplation.
The peripheral stations allow you to pause your journey and immerse yourself in the products away from the central focus.
The monolithic desk provides a final, grounding point of stillness to conclude your experience before exiting.
